title: Jonas Vingegaard abandons Tour de France after stage 15 crash
content:
Jonas Vingegaard has abandoned the Tour de France after crashing on the final descent of stage 15.

The two-time winner, 29, suffered a suspected broken collarbone, staying down for three minutes before being led into a waiting medical car.

Vingegaard has finished in the top two of the Tour in every year since 2021, alongside Tadej Pogacar, bringing to an end one of the most consistent achievements in modern cycling.

He has been the race leader’s closest competitor over the 14 previous days of racing, four minutes and 30 seconds behind the Slovenian on Sunday morning.

Vingegaard started his day at 2am after being woken up to do drug tests, saying it was “not the best night” as the doping protocol was “affecting performance and your sleep”.

“I guess the ITA didn’t allow me to sleep much,” he told TNT Sports before the stage. “I was sleeping very well but then somebody knocked on my door at 2am. It’s not the nicest at two o’clock. It took about 40 minutes before I was back in my room. It was not the best night.”

The Dane is the reigning champion of both the Vuelta a Espana and Giro d’Italia, and though behind Pogacar at the start of the day, was bidding to hold all three Grand Tours at once.

Pogacar’s UAE Team Emirates teammate Isaac Del Toro, sixth on GC entering the day, also fell, visibly holding his back on the rest of the descent.
